checks.evidence: Full Python unittest output for the release commit.
Wheel/sdist build output and portable ZIP smoke result.
Authenticode signature verification output for Windows executable/installers, including certificate subject, timestamp, and SHA256.
macOS codesign verification, notarization ticket/staple output, Gatekeeper assessment, and package SHA256.
Release artifact SHA256SUMS, dependency lock/build metadata, and SBOM or dependency inventory.
Windows and macOS checklist run from docs/rapidtriage-fresh-machine-smoke-test.md.
rapidtriage sample --run output with run summary, report, and searchable results.
rapidtriage benchmark JSON/Markdown attached to release notes.
docs/rapidtriage-parser-coverage.md and deterministic parser fixture tests.
docs/rapidtriage-known-limitations.md reviewed for the release version.
Submission bundle hash manifest, audit events, source paths, and review decisions.
Localhost default, remote auth-token requirement, path handling tests, and release notes warning.
Support contact, triage SLA, training material, escalation process, and emergency parser-fix policy for deployed users.

blocker_separation_profile.operator_rule: Do internal implementation/fixture/reporting work first, but keep commercial_grade=false until the paired trusted-tool, independent-review, signed-platform, large-hardware, or staffed-support evidence is attached.

score_strategy: Do not raise commercial-grade gates by wording alone.
Prioritize critical parser depth, then validation/legal, then performance and UX bottlenecks.
Attach real corpus, cross-tool diff, benchmark, or operator evidence before claiming commercial parity.
Use five-item batches so every uplift produces code, tests, docs, validation evidence, and a commit.

large_data_strategy.rule: Large evidence must be streamed, checkpointed, cursor-paged, and hash-referenced; UI and reports must never require loading all rows.
large_data_strategy.parser_runtime: Keep Python as orchestration/API/UI glue; move hot EVTX/Registry/ESE/MFT/USN/hash/OCR workers toward Rust or isolated native subprocesses.
large_data_strategy.storage: Use SQLite/PostgreSQL for case metadata, FTS/Tantivy-style indexes for search, and Parquet/DuckDB-style sidecars for large analytical outputs when needed.
large_data_strategy.api: Every massive table/search/timeline endpoint should expose cursor tokens, limits, total estimates, and snapshot warnings.
large_data_strategy.ui: Use virtualized result tables, lazy previews, dedupe collapse, and explicit loading/progress states.
large_data_strategy.proof: Publish benchmark JSON with hardware profile, evidence size, record count, wall time, peak memory, p95 latency, failures, and resume behavior.

commercial_gap_assessment.current_status: E01/Ex01 direct extraction works only when external libewf/Sleuth Kit tools are present; other image families are detected with guidance.
commercial_gap_assessment.needed_for_commercial_parity: Read-only native or orchestrated handling for raw/split images, AD1/L01/Lx01, AFF/AFF4, VHD/VHDX, VMDK, VDI, XVA, QCOW/QCOW2, ISO, DMG, WIM/SWM, and reliable partition/filesystem selection.
commercial_gap_assessment.operator_workaround: Mount or export with validated forensic tooling and scan the resulting folder.

commercial_gap_assessment.current_status: EVTX native scanning is partial but now preserves common BinXML scalar values, SIDs, TemplateInstance IDs, message-rendering provenance, native chunk structure rows, and cautious slack/deleted/corrupt record candidate metadata; MFT/USN support includes imports plus bounded native inventory/USN record recovery; registry/OS-account support includes exports, inventory-level native hive parsing, hbin-aware bounded key-tree rows, key/value recovery candidates, SAM account/RID candidates, service/mounted-device/LSA/privilege export rows, and first-pass NTUSER/UsrClass user-activity pivots; execution support includes Amcache/ShimCache/BAM/UserAssist exports, native Amcache path/hash candidates, SRUM imports, and SRUDB table/string pivots; Windows.edb includes direct ESE header and bounded string-pivot inventory but not full table decoding.
commercial_gap_assessment.needed_for_commercial_parity: Full EVTX BinXML/provider message resource rendering, native Registry hive transaction-log replay, deep NTUSER.DAT/UsrClass.dat binary value decoding and deleted-value testimony validation, full SAM F/V and SECURITY secret decoding, native Amcache/ShimCache/BAM binary decoding, SRUDB ESE table/page row decoding, Windows.edb ESE, $MFT, $UsnJrnl, JumpList, ShellBags, and Prefetch parsers with validation corpora.
commercial_gap_assessment.operator_workaround: Import exports from trusted tools such as EvtxECmd, Hayabusa, Chainsaw, Velociraptor, PECmd, MFTECmd, and SRUM/EDB export utilities.

commercial_gap_assessment.current_status: APK triage includes permissions, dex/native inventory, and bounded string/URL/IP pivots; cloud export imports, Volatility-style output imports, and bounded direct memory dump indicator scans exist; direct acquisition and deep native analysis are not implemented.
commercial_gap_assessment.needed_for_commercial_parity: Vendor package importers, app database parsers, direct cloud/API acquisition workflows, full raw memory process reconstruction, validated BitLocker key workflows, and malware process scoring.
commercial_gap_assessment.operator_workaround: Use Cellebrite/XRY/GrayKey/AXIOM/cloud provider exports and Volatility outputs, then import the resulting folder/files; validate direct memory string/key candidates before reporting.

commercial_gap_assessment.current_status: Source/wheel build and launchers exist, but signed Windows/macOS installers and notarization are outside the repo.
